correctness.rationale: Stationarity gives the heightwise conditional law E[x^2|z]=bz; the explicit polynomial W=xy-z+z^2/2+(a/2)x^2 has Lie derivative y^2-bz(z-1), yielding the exact square defect. Compact-support invariance classifies equality as the three-equilibrium simplex, and conditional positivity proves the simultaneous strict excursion barrier.

originality.rationale: Prior work on the model covers its bifurcations, dynamics at infinity, Lorenz attractors, and integrability/Rucklidge equivalence. Targeted exact and equivalent searches did not locate the conditional stationary law, square defect with complete equality rigidity, or the joint threshold. Residual risk from incompletely inspected older and equivalent-system literature is recorded.

value.rationale: The theorem gives parameter-uniform, exact stationary constraints for all compact invariant measures and converts them into a sharp geometric diagnostic: every genuinely non-equilibrium stationary state must visit z>1 and |x|>sqrt(b) simultaneously.
